title: DNS Record Lookup
description: DNS is like the phonebook of the internet. It translates website names (like example.com) into computer numbers (IP addresses). Different record types do different things: A/AAAA control website paths, MX routes emails, and TXT handles security and verification.
tips: If the 'A' record is missing, the web address won't load in a browser.
If 'MX' records are wrong, you won't be able to receive emails on that domain.
